title: Principal/set args
description: Arguments for Principal/set (RFC 9670 §3.3). Only self-updates are allowed; create and destroy are not permitted for most principals.

accountId.description: The account to apply changes to.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard. Fails with stateMismatch if the Principal state differs.

create.description: Always results in notCreated for server-managed principals.

update.description: Map of PrincipalId to PatchObject. Only the calling user's own principal may be updated.

destroy.description: Always results in notDestroyed for server-managed principals.
